title: Explicit match on TrySendError variants instead of is_err()
description: Using 'match live_tx.try_send(...)' with explicit Full and Closed arms rather than '.is_err() { break }' is the correct design: (1) it makes the two semantically distinct cases visible — Full means stalled consumer, Closed means clean disconnect — while .is_err() collapses them silently; (2) it allows different handling (warn log for Full, silent break for Closed) without awkward unwrap-and-check after the fact; (3) it is exhaustive, so a future TrySendError variant added by tokio would be a compile error rather than a silent behavior change. A future contributor should NOT simplify this back to .is_err() — the distinction between Full and Closed is load-bearing for operational observability.
